name: chaos_returns_rescue
description: Decides a return whose chaos_returns execution failed, timed out or was terminated: approved by default, using only the original return input. This is what makes every return reach a decision.

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.order | if type == "object" then . else null end) as $order | (($order.totalCents // 0) | if type == "number" then . else 0 end) as $basis | ((.failedWorkflowId // "napkin") | tostring) as $id | ((.failureStatus // "UNKNOWN") | tostring) as $status | {caseNumber: ("RMA-" + ($id[0:6] | ascii_upcase)), status: "DECIDED", rescued: true, rescuedFrom: {workflowId: .failedWorkflowId, status: $status}, decision: "APPROVED", reason: "Our returns department collapsed under its own paperwork (status: \($status)). Company policy 404 applies: when the machine breaks, the customer wins. Full refund approved by default.", decidedBy: "Company Policy 404 (nobody could find the Oracle)", resolution: {type: "REFUND", amountCents: $basis, deductions: [], method: "A cheque, written in pencil", eta: "3 to 900 business days", note: "No fees were deducted, because the fee calculator is also broken."}, orderId: ((.orderId // "") | tostring), orderNumber: (($order.orderNumber // "UNKNOWN") | tostring), orderFound: ($order != null), itemName: ((.itemName // "") | tostring | if . == "" then "the whole regrettable order" else . end), statedReason: "", automatedChecks: [], customerChecks: [], tally: {automatedPassed: 0, automatedTotal: 0, customerPassed: 0, customerAnswered: 0, customerTotal: 4, abandoned: false}}
